name: Pagination
summary: Navigation between the pages of a long list or table, with Previous and Next.
use: Tables and search results with a fixed number of items per page.
avoid: Feeds where scrolling on makes more sense: think about "Load more".
behaviour: Previous is disabled on page 1, Next on the last page.
a11y: <nav> with an aria-label. Current page with aria-current="page".
do: Show the total number of results nearby.
dont: Pagination with fewer than two pages.
